extName.message: Full Page PDF Snap – Save Webpage as PDF

extDescription.message: Save any webpage as a single high-resolution PDF. Auto-scrolls the whole page — no cropping, no print dialog.

actionTitle.message: Full Page PDF Snap — save the whole page as PDF

commandCapture.message: Save the whole page as PDF

popupHeading.message: Save the whole page as PDF

internalPage.message: Internal browser page (settings, store, add-on pages) — please switch to a normal website (https://…).

protectedPage.message: The browser protects this page. Please switch to a normal website (e.g. wikipedia.org).

noScripts.message: This page does not allow extension scripts.

incompleteHint.message: Parts of the page could not be captured completely:

menuCapture.message: Save the whole page as PDF

menuSaveAs.message: Ask where to save every time

optIntro.message: Save the whole page as a high-resolution PDF via auto-scroll.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save every time

optSinglePage.message: One continuous page (default — no visible seams)

optHideStickyHint.message: Hide sidebars and top bars before capture. Navigation columns are kept once at the top.

optLayoutContext.message: Menu once at the top, content below (default)

optAppLayoutHint.message: On pages that scroll their content in a separate area, the header and sidebar stay in place and would otherwise appear in every section of the PDF. Has no effect on ordinary pages.

optAfterBoth.message: Show folder and open the PDF

optAfterHint.message: Default is "Show folder": after saving, the download folder opens with the file preselected. "Open the PDF" starts the PDF viewer instead, "Both" does one after the other.

optScaleHint.message: Default is 1.0x: the PDF shows the page exactly as it appears on screen — enough for normal printing at 144 dpi. Higher values sharpen the text but fit less into the window, so menus and sidebars end earlier.

optLanguageHint.message: Interface language. "Automatic" follows the browser language, otherwise English. The name shown in the store always follows the browser language — an extension cannot influence that.

optSubfolderHint.message: Default: Full Page PDF Snap. Leave empty to save directly into Downloads/. For security reasons the browser only allows subfolders.

optSaveAsHint.message: Enable this if you want to save into folders outside Downloads/.

optCounterHint.message: Increases by one with every new PDF. Reset sets it back to zero.

optPdfFormatHint.message: A single continuous page removes the visible seams between segments. Multi-page splits the result into pages of the height set below.

optPageHeightHint.message: Only relevant when "Multiple pages" is selected. Default 2400 px.

optShortcutNone.message: none assigned — conflicts with a browser shortcut

optShortcutHint.message: Shown here is the shortcut the browser has actually assigned. Browser shortcuts always take precedence and cannot be overridden by an extension — if the field says none, the combination is taken by the browser itself. To change it, open the address next to the button in a new tab.

optShortcutCopied.message: Address copied — paste it into a new tab

optShortcutWhere.message: To change it, open this address in a new tab:

resultTitle.message: Capture ready — Full Page PDF Snap

resultNoPreview.message: The preview cannot be shown here.

resultShareHint.message: This browser cannot pass files to other apps directly. The PDF opens in the app chooser — share it from there.

resultGone.message: No capture available. Start a new one from the extension icon.

optProvenance.message: Add a provenance line below the capture

optProvenanceHint.message: Writes the page address, the time of capture and a SHA-256 checksum of the image data into a strip under the image. Useful when the file has to be filed or handed on. A screen capture is not a qualified electronic document: the time comes from your device clock, and the checksum shows the file has not changed since it was made — not that the page looked this way. The same details are always written into the PDF metadata, with or without this option.

optTimeAnchorHint.message: Fetches a public random value from the decentralised drand network before saving and writes it into the capture. Because nobody could know that value beforehand, it shows the capture is not older than that moment — without relying on your device clock. This is the only network access this extension makes, it is off unless you switch it on, and nothing is sent: the page, the capture and its checksum never leave your device. It still does not prove what the page showed, and it is not a qualified electronic timestamp under eIDAS. If the network is unavailable, the capture is saved without the anchor.

optTextLayer.message: Make the PDF searchable (invisible text layer)

optTextLayerHint.message: Copies the page's own text into the PDF, invisibly, at the position where it appears in the image. The PDF becomes searchable and the text can be copied — without changing how it looks. The text is taken from the document, not recognised from the image: measured on a real page, every word survives, where OCR recovered 92.6 percent. Only applies to the one-continuous-page format.

popupHideOverlaysHint.message: Consent dialogs and floating bars are hidden for the capture and restored afterwards.

popupHideOff.message: Banners will be captured as they are

regionHint.message: Drag to select an area · Esc cancels

popupCiteHint.message: Authors, DOI, licence and retrieval time into the PDF, plus an RIS record. For AI tools to read them too, also switch on the provenance line in the settings.

optCopyPath.message: Copy the file path to the clipboard after saving

optCopyPathHint.message: For handing the file straight to a terminal or a language model: capture, then paste. Off by default.

optCopyPathFormatHint.message: A Windows path pasted into a Linux shell under Windows leads nowhere. Choosing WSL converts it once here instead of every time by hand.

popupCopyPathHint.message: Paste the path straight into a terminal or a chat. Format for WSL and other shells in the settings.

popupCopyOn.message: Path will be copied after saving

optColourModeHint.message: Greyscale and black and white cut the file to 58 % and 27 % — and they help OCR rather than hurt it: 989 words read back against 987 in colour. Pages with photographs need colour.

optSourceMetadata.message: Read citation details from the page

optSourceMetadataHint.message: Reads authors, journal, volume, DOI, licence and access time from the page that is already open, and writes them into the PDF metadata plus an attached RIS record for Citavi, Zotero and EndNote. No request is made to any service.

optPageFormatHint.message: A4 derives the page height from the captured width, so a printed page fills the sheet without scaling.

optBreakAtLines.message: Break between lines, not through them

optBreakAtLinesHint.message: Moves each page break up to the nearest gap between text lines, images and tables. Measured on four publisher pages: 30 of 46 fixed-grid breaks cut through a line of text, 2 of 47 did with this setting on. Cost: 1–3 % empty margin per page.

optFetchOriginal.message: Also download the publisher's original file

optFetchOriginalHint.message: Off by default: this is the only feature that opens a network connection. It downloads the full-text address the page itself declares — the same request a click on "PDF" makes, with the same access rights. Nothing behind a paywall becomes reachable.

optNoReviewHint.message: Do not ask me to rate this extension. It asks once, after five captures, and never again — this switch prevents even that one.

optLinkMap.message: Save a link map beside the PDF

optLinkMapHint.message: A JSON file listing every link on the page: where it sits in the image, where it leads, and what part of the page it belongs to — navigation, footer, content, pagination. For AI tools that have to find their way to a goal: on one encyclopedia page, 741 of 1,528 links turned out to be page furniture and could be ruled out before searching. Costs one extra file per capture.
